latest.title: Grow-up rates of inhomogeneous semilinear heat equations in the critical dimension
latest.abstract: This paper concerns the grow-up rate of solutions to a semilinear heat equation in the unit ball with the exponential nonlinearity and an inhomogeneous term $f$. When $f=0$, it is known that the large-time behavior of a solution changes at the critical dimension $N=10$, and the grow-up phenomenon occurs for the case $N\ge 10$. For the inhomogeneous case with $N\ge 10$, the present author and a coauthor showed in [12] that the grow-up phenomenon disappears once $f$ exceeds a threshold. In this paper, we provide a quantitative characterization of the disappearance of the grow-up phenomenon by obtaining the grow-up rate in the critical dimension. Our result shows that a qualitatively different type of grow-up behavior occurs in the critical dimension compared with the case $N\ge 11$ studied in [12]. The difference is caused by a change in the outer behavior of the solution. Even in the case $f=0$, our result is new in that it provides a rigorous justification of the formal computation by Galaktionov and King [10].
latest.workSummary: 论文研究临界维数奇异椭圆问题的径向解，构造奇异稳态并分析 $N=10$ 情形的长时间首项修正。
latest.breakthrough: Theorem 1.6 给出 $N=10$ 的 leading-order expansion，补充 $N\ge 11$ 与临界维数之间的差异。
latest.limitations: 结论采用径向对称、比较源项和文中奇异边界条件；临界情形依赖第一本征模的投影控制。

steps.route: 第2.1节将椭圆方程化为径向 ODE，以奇异主项为边界条件并用单调性/比较原理证明唯一性。

steps.claim: Lemmas 3.1–3.3 控制临界模态和调制系数。
